verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
GGWE okooye-,onafuwadde-,
Ozitoowereddwa?
Jjangu,Yesu agambye nti:
Wummula

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Naamutegeera ntya-?Enkovu
Z'emisumaali,
Ku bibatu,ku kigere,
Kwe ziri.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Bwe naamugobereranga,
Naaweebwanga ki?
Onoolabanga-obulumi
N'akabi.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Bwe naatambulanga naye,
Alimpeera ki?
Oliwangula-amagombe
N'Okufa.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Bwe naamwegayirira nti
Onnyanirize;
Anangoba? Nedda,nedda,
T'ayinze.

verse.name: v7
